description: RAIN watches your visits, reminders and coverage for you — the pending confirmation, the telehealth option and the unanswered reminders surface here before you have to ask, in English or Spanish, on the channels you consented to.
Your visit status, reminder history and confirmation path come back as one answer computed live from your own record — not a form to fill or a phone queue to wait in.
The pattern profile knows the long drive raises your no-show risk, so the platform lines up the telehealth switch before the visit is at risk — you just reply T.
Confirmations, switches and reschedules fire straight from a reply — the clinic systems update instantly, and anything unclear routes to a person instead of blocking your care.
